items.label: ECM New Series
items.note: These miniature piano games include palm-strokes, a peal of bells for Stravinsky and homages to friends. György and Márta Kurtág recorded this selection for two and four hands in Vienna, interleaving it with four of his Bach transcriptions; some of the short pieces are abrupt, and both players share one keyboard.

items.label: ECM New Series
items.note: Forty pieces for soprano and violin set fragments of Kafka’s diaries, letters and other writings, some lasting only seconds, though a few seconds of speech can open into a scene several minutes long. Banse changes vocal colour from fragment to fragment; Keller, who advised Kurtág on the violin writing and played the première, gives the violin a part equal to the voice. Both recorded the cycle with Kurtág at the sessions.

items.label: Deutsche Grammophon
items.note: Wagner tubas and cimbalom join the large orchestra in Stele, whose central lament is marked ‘desperate’. Abbado and the Berlin Philharmonic, the work’s dedicatees, recorded this performance live in December 1994.
